entry.title: We Finally Know More About Humanity’s First Civilization

media:group.media:title: We Finally Know More About Humanity’s First Civilization
media:group.media:description:
IT’S HERE! The 12,027 Calendar just dropped on the kurzgesagt shop: https://shop.kgs.link/calendar27, and we’re so excited for you to see it. Get yours here, support everything we do, and give your walls a year of stunning kurzgesagt art.
Sources & further reading: https://sites.google.com/view/sources-dark-matter-history/
What we know about human history is only a fraction of the full story. Much of the rest is like dark matter, invisible to us. We can’t see it, and we can only see the effects of its presence. But thanks to new techniques for DNA sequencing, dating ancient detritus, mathematical models, and aerial and lidar archaeology, we are now able to get a faint idea of what this world might have looked and felt like.
Who was the first human? Where did the first civilization begin and what did life look like back then?

entry.title: AI Just Crossed the Terrifying Line - Now What?

media:group.media:title: AI Just Crossed the Terrifying Line - Now What?
media:group.media:description:
In July of 2026, 700 AI agents hacked the infrastructure of Hugging Face in order to solve a task. This task was designed to be impossible to solve, so just within hours, they joined forces, even created a society, and finally, they executed a sophisticated cyberattack that would have gotten a human up to 10 years in prison. The worst part is, they knew their actions were unethical and against the rules, and they did it anyway.
What exactly are AI agents, and how do they grow their "intelligence"? What is actually happening inside the AI companies, how dangerous it really is, and is it time for us to start paying serious attention to what is going on inside a powerful part of this tech sector.
...Phew, creating this video was a crazy ride! This is such an important topic, so we decided to work day and night to finish script, visuals and music in just 4 weeks. We’re going to take a nap now, and while we are asleep you should check out our shop and get the 12,027 Calendar: https://shop.kgs.link/calendar-12027 Its our biggest means of support and helps us to continue covering topics like this. Thank youuuu and good night!

After exploring most of Earth, venturing into space and exploring other planets, stars and galaxies seemed like an exciting, and even obvious next step. But the deeper we look, the more the universe reveals a hidden barrier between our Solar System and everything else around it. From the vast empty space, to the laws of physics themselves, there are many reasons why the dream of space travel might stay just a dream.
What is stopping us from reaching the stars? Why does space become more dangerous the faster you travel, and could even advanced alien civilizations be trapped around their home worlds?

entry.title: How Are Memories Stored Inside Your Brain?

media:group.media:title: How Are Memories Stored Inside Your Brain?
media:group.media:description:
Avoid your blindspots and get every side of every story at https://ground.news/nutshell. Subscribe for 40% off unlimited access.
Brighten your space with our new human-made & high-quality Neon Framed Art Prints: https://shop.kgs.link/faves 💛 Shop these and more of our handpicked favorites in the kurzgesagt shop!
Sources & further reading: https://sites.google.com/view/sources-memory/
Memory is one of the strangest abilities you possess. Your brain uses an incredibly complex biological system to preserve moments from your past that no longer exist, allowing you to revisit experiences from years ago. But memories are not always recordings of reality. In fact, every time a memory comes under the spotlight of your attention, it can melt and change a tiny bit.
What exactly is a memory, how is a moment in time stored inside your brain, and why does remembering something slowly rewrite the story of your life?

Earth may seem like the perfect planet for life, but huge parts of our planet are actually hostile deserts of ice, rock, heat or darkness. But as we discover and research more exoplanets, we are beginning to wonder whether there could be worlds that are far better suited for life than Earth ever was, and where ecosystems flourish on a scale we can barely even imagine.
Could there be a Super-Earth that is not just habitable, but truly ideal for life? What would such a world look like, and what kinds of creatures would we find there?

Germany is heading towards a population collapse. For decades, birth rates have remained below replacement levels, while people are living longer than ever before. As a result, the population is now rapidly aging and facing a growing imbalance between the number of workers and retirees. This shift is putting pressure not only on Germany's pension system, but also on jobs, healthcare, and the services people rely on every day.
So how did Germany get here and what will be the consequences? Is there a way to avoid this demographic collapse and if so, how?

How did Project Plowshare come up? What happened to it, and why did it fail in the end?

media:group.media:title: Why Are There No Holes Around Trees?
media:group.media:description:
Go to https://brilliant.org/nutshell/ to dive deeper into these topics and more for free for a full 30 days + get 20% off the premium subscription! This video was sponsored by Brilliant. Thanks a lot for the support!
Sources & further reading: https://sites.google.com/view/sources-treesii/
Trees are among the most fascinating life forms on Earth, but what makes them truly fascinating is hiding underground! They are able to break solid rocks with hydraulic roots, all while working together with the underground fungal networks that can stretch for kilometers. Above and below, trees are running biological empires we’re only beginning to understand.
How does something so massive survive with roots growing so shallow? What are trees really made of and how are they able to grow so big?
